justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayFill.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayFillTest.java. ArrayFill is a 199-line final utility with 10 public static fill overloads plus a private constructor; every method implements the same single concern of filling arrays (delegating to Arrays.fill or iterating once for the generator overload). The tests cover that one cohesive responsibility across primitive and object arrays, and I saw no distinct secondary responsibility or low-cohesion method groups that would justify splitting the class.
